mapper.select: SELECT a.ANALYSIS_ID, a.RECONCILIATION_ID, a.MODEL_ID, a.PERIOD, a.DIFF_REASON, a.DIFF_DESCRIPTION, a.SOLUTION, a.ADJUST_AMOUNT, a.STATUS, a.HANDLER, a.HANDLER_NAME, a.HANDLE_TIME, a.TENANT_ID, a.CREATE_USER, a.CREATE_TIME, a.UPDATE_USER, a.UPDATE_TIME, m.MODEL_NAME, r.COMPANY_A_NAME, r.COMPANY_B_NAME, r.DIFF_AMOUNT, r.TRANSACTION_TYPE FROM TBL_RECONCILIATION_ANALYSIS a LEFT JOIN TBL_CONSOLIDATION_MODEL m ON a.MODEL_ID = m.MODEL_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_RECONCILIATION_DATA r ON a.RECONCILIATION_ID = r.RECONCILIATION_ID WHERE a.RECONCILIATION_ID = #{reconciliationId}
SELECT STATUS, COUNT(1) AS COUNT FROM TBL_RECONCILIATION_ANALYSIS WHERE MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND PERIOD = #{period} GROUP BY STATUS
SELECT DIFF_REASON, COUNT(1) AS COUNT FROM TBL_RECONCILIATION_ANALYSIS WHERE MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND PERIOD = #{period} GROUP BY DIFF_REASON
